reviewer: Codex; scoped migration review, hardware qualification recorded separately

records.reason: Retain SDK-independent unsafe backend contract with per-thread context binding, completion and ownership requirements. Provider/context/ordinal identify addresses and streams; no raw SDK handle is treated as interchangeable across vendors. ActualAscend allocator/copy and independentKVBM tests exercise the implementation.

Retain versioned platform descriptor, explicit available/unavailable/unknown capabilities and contextual requirements; validate unique device IDs and nonzero capacities. Available capability reports do not assert certification. No tested-TP whitelist introduced.

Retain bounded asynchronous-copy reservations and resource-owning reaper; canceled receipts do not free DMA buffers. Checked ranges/context/alignment, failed-submit stream fallback and fail-safe quarantine remain. SDK fault quarantine can deliberately retain resources and is not an unbounded leak-free guarantee; final live normal/cancel paths passed.

Retain provider-owned allocation through MemoryDescriptor/Buffer ownership, preserving explicit device_identity. Return no NIXL descriptor instead of mislabeling vendor allocation as CUDA. Transfer registration remains delegated to vendor M05 path.

Target delta only guards NIXL imports/method/trait behind its feature and adds attribution. Original CUDA allocation/drop semantics unchanged; Ascend does not require NIXL when building its native path. No CUDA hardware regression claimed.
